units: <cite ref="Gittin 69b:10">Gitt. 69ᵇ</cite> <he>לט׳</he> for pain in the milt.
<cite ref="Chullin 93a:11">Ib.</cite> <he>דט׳ וכ׳</he> the veins (sinews) of milts must be removed as fat; v. <cite ref="H00299"><he>חוּטָא</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Chullin 111a:9">Ib. 111ᵃ</cite> <he>תבשילא דט׳</he> a dish of pieces of milt.
